exec-server: preserve fs helper runtime env

Carry a small allowlist of runtime environment variables into sandboxed fs helper launches so the Linux sandbox can discover system bubblewrap on PATH while still avoiding broad env propagation.

Add unit coverage for the fs helper env allowlist and a Linux integration smoke that injects a fake bwrap on PATH, runs a sandboxed file-system write through the helper, and verifies the bwrap path was exercised.

workflow_runs.display_title: [6/6] Fail exec client operations after disconnect

head_commit.message:
Fail exec client operations after disconnect

Reject new exec-server operations once the transport disconnects and convert pending RPC calls into closed errors. This lets remote MCP stdio calls surface executor loss immediately instead of waiting for the MCP tool timeout.

infrastructure and introduces the new v2 menu. The menu now groups
plugins into All Plugins, Installed, OpenAI Curated, and per-marketplace
tabs.

- Add All Plugins, Installed, OpenAI Curated, and per-marketplace tabs
- Preserve active tab and selected-row behavior across popup refreshes
- Add duplicate marketplace tab-label disambiguation
- Update browse-mode popup tests and snapshots
